items.title: Second place at the Aggie Invitational
items.body: San Marin competed at the overnight Aggie Invitational against some of the strongest programs in the Bay Area. In Varsity, Sophia & Nora and Chase Cloney & Logan Alsterlind both went undefeated in prelims and broke to elimination rounds. Logan and Chase then won their quarterfinal and semifinal to reach the finals, finishing second overall, the best result in San Marin Debate history. Novices Zainab Syed and Claire Yeo also went undefeated and move up to JV. Thank you to head coach Karen Kenyon, assistant coach Carina Masters, teacher advisor Tim Blok, and parent judges Linda Schiltgen, Amar Lal, and Jim Glogoza.

items.title: Two promotions at San Ramon
items.body: Our second parli tournament of the year was at San Ramon High School in Danville, with 20 students competing. In Junior Varsity, Dylan Lendler & Milo McBride had a winning record and move up to Varsity. In Novice, Caroline Cook & Isabella Hernandez had a winning record and move up to JV. Congratulations to both teams, and thank you to the parents who drove and judged: Mr. Lendler, Ms. Schiltgen, Ms. Liu, Ms. Alsterlind, Ms. Bayar and Ms. Cook.

items.title: First tournament at Miramonte
items.body: The season opened at Miramonte High School, with new members competing for the first time and returning debaters showing how much they have grown. Michelle Anand & Zoe Knecht went undefeated in Novice and move up to JV. Hamza Wadera & Alexander Cameron and Hannah Yako & Chloe Ru earned winning records in JV and move up to Varsity. Logan Alsterlind & Chase Cloney earned a winning record in Varsity. Thank you to Coach Kenyon, our parent judges and drivers, and our officers.
